script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: It gives a reason Samuel speaks plainly that the text does not give. Marking it as Papa's guess does not permit an invented reason.
The narrowing cookie-order comparison repeats the joke idea from card 5, answer 1.
It asserts that there are no name tags at the gathering, a detail the text does not give.
The name-tag joke does not make sense: name tags would help distinguish people, not mix them up.
It states that the people do not panic or guess, neither of which the text says.
“No sleeping on it” rules out a delay the text does not address.
The text says they looked for Saul, not that the whole nation was looking.
The explanation assumes a resting man would be spotted quickly, though someone could rest out of sight among baggage.
It identifies Samuel as a prophet without a reference for that fact from outside the passage.
The roof joke suggests putting a scroll there would cause a windy afternoon, so the comparison does not make sense.
Papa puts himself in a group chat, rather than treating it as something people outside his bakery use.
“No big showdown” and “He just lets it pass” go beyond the text, which says only that Saul remained silent about it.
